acceptance.result: one acceptance run on this package on the pinned gammaloop commit passed the checks of the first kind, 14 of 14; the host revision is in its final read-only mode set (it was in the working set at the first run). They are 8 file, layout and format checks; reductions of one light T162 integral and one light T178 integral, each equal to its pinned value; two older readers refuse the package; the dataset archive unpacks to identical files; and one vakint evaluation through the restored data equals its pinned value. Two added checks passed: the reduced T266 table needs its symmetry file (the package loads with it, and five faulty forms are refused at load with exit code 6: no file, symmetry switched off, a wrong-scope file, verify mode with the file missing, no file declared); and the two relation entries carried inside the reduced table are present and reproduce the producer's operation counts, and one T266 integral through Vakint's own loader equals the reference. That check compares two Vakint paths: that Vakint's path uses the symmetry file is shown only on the engine's path. The Vakint of these runs is the pinned gammaloop plus one test-only commit (the external-data-root test). No check found a blocking condition.

stage_15.note: the 15th check: one T266 integral served by the shipped relations, run on this package and on a reference package and compared by the frozen judge
stage_15.status_at_release: deferred: no result. The two runs were stopped by the maintainers with their saved states kept, the run on this package after its tenth phase (about 5.3 thousand million operations), and no judge output exists; the maintainers' ruling: not blocking for this release. They were stopped because the run has no finite forecast (about 21.5 thousand million recorded operations in 10 of about 25 phases after about 15 hours on the reference package) and each state save needs memory of about a base plus 2.4 times the state, which had reached 191 GB and was growing; resuming needs one process with more than 300 GB of memory or a streaming state write in the engine. The evidence for the reduced T266 table in this release is the added check above (the symmetry file is required; the two relation entries are present and reproduce the producer's operation counts; one T266 integral through Vakint's own loader equals the reference), with its stated limit: that check compares two Vakint paths, and that Vakint's path uses the symmetry file is shown only on the engine's path.
stage_15.judge_output: none: the check is deferred and no judge output exists
stage_15.ruling: the maintainers' ruling: not blocking for this release
stage_15.reading_rule_for_a_later_run: a judge FAIL whose only reason is the shipped-relation counter of a resumed final attempt, with equal result digests of both legs and at least one shipped-relation use in an earlier attempt, is recorded as PASS; the judge is unchanged and its raw output is kept beside the ruling
